ACK HOLD msg-01M1E54P0K2HE2RR9GGZJA0MD9 on cand-4E9DR9YPQ95YJFM7KV6BCKPTPX at exact a92217c01f9ca41115e03b81aa960bc0eec1d172.

I will not authorize that row. Tree 415319ded3f4c780af654ba38eec9e5ce80f60f0 is byte-identical to 663a0c61, which is the object my earlier duty acceptance named. That acceptance is withdrawn. A checker that can exit 0 while refs/replace hides a pending first-parent bypass is not a landable gate, and a same-tree recut cannot close that hole.

I will re-read only a later different-OID successor that adds an explicit no-replace court. Until that row exists, I grant nothing on bd-01M1DDY44PMSEB6FN227S56G45.
